ew to the new. I' with a new video. Today I'm going to show you how to make a simple yet delicious chicken curry. First, gather your ingredients: boneless, skinless chicken thighs, coconut milk, onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric, coriander, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. You'll also need some oil for cooking. Start by heating a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add a tablespoon of oil, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Next, add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute until fragrant. Now it's time to add the spices. Add the curry powder, turmeric, coriander, cumin, and chili powder to the pot. Stir constantly for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Be careful not to burn the spices. Add the chicken thighs to the pot and cook until lightly browned on all sides. This will help seal in the juices and add flavor. Pour in the coconut milk, then add salt and pepper to taste. Bring the curry to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the pot and shred it into bite-sized pieces using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot and stir to combine with the sauce. Serve your chicken curry hot with a side of steamed rice or naan bread. Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired. Enjoy your homemade chicken curry! It's a flavorful and satisfying meal that's perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
